# Dispatch

> Dispatch sends personal cold-outreach campaigns from your own Gmail account. You write a message once, add recipients, and Dispatch sends them one at a time on a paced schedule, with open and click tracking, a one-click unsubscribe link in every message, and an optional follow-up in the same thread. Built by Kairos AI Tech.

## Key facts

- Works with Gmail and Google Workspace accounts only (it sends through the Gmail API).
- Asks Google for one Gmail permission, sending mail. It cannot read, modify or delete messages, so replies arrive in Gmail as usual, but Dispatch cannot detect them and does not track reply stats.
- Pacing: about one minute between messages, with a daily cap. Messages over the cap roll into the next day.
- Imported campaigns (CSV upload, Gmail add-on, API key) always arrive as drafts. Nothing sends until the user presses Send.
- The API key can only import campaigns. It cannot send mail or change the Gmail connection.
- Every message carries an unsubscribe link. Unsubscribed addresses go on a suppression list that applies to all of the user's campaigns.
- Not included: lead database, email warm-up, multichannel (LinkedIn, SMS, calling) sequences.

## Pricing (USD)

- Free: $0. 20 sends a day, 1 Gmail mailbox, tracking, a follow-up, API import.
- Pro: $19 a month, or $15 a month billed yearly ($180). 500 sends a day, 3 Gmail mailboxes.

## Comparison (public pricing pages, checked October 2026)

- GMass: Gmail extension for campaigns from the compose window. No free plan (free trial). From $29.95 a month ($20 billed yearly). Sequences from the $39.95 plan.
- Mailmeteor: mail merge with Google Sheets automations. Free plan with 50 sends a day. From $5.99 a month. Follow-ups from the $17.99 plan.
- Yet Another Mail Merge: mail merge from Google Sheets. Free plan with 20 recipients a day. Pro limits 400 a day (Gmail) or 1,500 (Workspace). Prices not listed on its pricing page.
- Instantly: high-volume cold email across many inboxes, plus a lead database. No free plan. From about $47 a month.
- lemlist: multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, SMS, calling). 14-day free trial. Email plan $69 a month ($55 billed yearly).
